mapper.sql: select e.employee_id, e.user_id, e.employee_no, e.name, e.gender, e.birthday, e.id_card, e.phone, e.dept_id, e.post_id, e.education, e.entry_date, e.probation_end_date, e.formal_date, e.contract_expire_date, e.base_salary, e.status, e.leave_date, e.leave_reason, e.create_by, e.create_time, e.update_by, e.update_time, e.remark, d.dept_name, u.user_name from hr_employee e left join sys_dept d on d.dept_id = e.dept_id left join sys_user u on u.user_id = e.user_id
mapper.select: where e.status in ('1', '2') and e.contract_expire_date is not null and e.contract_expire_date <= date_add(curdate(), interval #{days} day) order by e.contract_expire_date
mapper.insert: insert into hr_employee (user_id, employee_no, name, gender, birthday, id_card, phone, dept_id, post_id, education, entry_date, probation_end_date, formal_date, contract_expire_date, base_salary, status, create_by, create_time, remark) values (#{userId}, #{employeeNo}, #{name}, #{gender}, #{birthday}, #{idCard}, #{phone}, #{deptId}, #{postId}, #{education}, #{entryDate}, #{probationEndDate}, #{formalDate}, #{contractExpireDate}, #{baseSalary}, #{status}, #{createBy}, sysdate(), #{remark})
